    "Effectively centralizes customer communications for emails, chat, and calls.",

  "cons": [
    "Can become costly as the company grows and requires more advanced features.",
    "New reporting features may provide data that is hard to digest or inaccurate.",
    "There can be a learning curve for new team members to fully utilize the system."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This CEO likely found Freshdesk to be a highly effective solution for managing customer communications and organizing support tickets for their 51-200 employee company over two years. The platform's comprehensive functionality and ease of use were significant benefits, making customer support more streamlined. While generally positive, concerns about pricing as the team expands and potential issues with new reporting features might temper their enthusiasm slightly."
